name: Crawling Sensation
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may mill two cards. (You may put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.)
Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires when one or more cards matching a filter (here: land cards, owner = you) are put into a graveyard from ANY zone -- battlefield, hand (discard), library (mill, surveil), stack -- supporting `batched: true` so one simultaneous move of several land cards triggers once, and `max_per_turn: 1` for "for the first time each turn"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no generic zone-change-to-graveyard event: leaves_battlefield with to_zones ["graveyard"] (and dies) only sees permanents leaving the battlefield and misses milled and discarded land cards, which is what this card's own upkeep mill feeds; discard covers only the hand; leaves_graveyard is the opposite direction. The upkeep `may` + `mill` line and the insect_1_1_g token are expressible today.
